subject: Refund — this is unacceptable
body:
This is the THIRD time I've contacted you about this. My device has failed twice in six months and the latest replacement won't even pair.

I want a full refund and I'm done with your company. I've already filed a complaint with the BBB.

The order number is PPI-9847.

Don't tell me to reset it again.

— K. Martinez
